summary: In an executive office, Agents Jones and Brown burst in on Agent Smith, who has Morpheus in custody. When Brown demands to know what Smith was doing, Jones cuts him off with 'You don't know,' and Smith plays ignorant, asking 'Know what?' Smith then listens to his earphone and is left disbelieving what he hears.

what_changes.after: Releases him as the other agents arrive.
Listening to his earphone, not believing what he is hearing.
what_changes.evidence: Agent Smith listens to his earphone, not believing what he is hearing.

event_hint.one_line: The agents regroup after taking Morpheus, and Smith receives shocking news through his earphone.

uncertain: What Agent Smith was actually doing when the others burst in.
What Smith is hearing through his earphone that he cannot believe.
